items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nobody could be more of a gentleman than Billy Higgins.

ctx.x: Yes, it was a quartet. So Billy Higgins played the first set, did you play that same night?
Yeah I played the second set. From then on, Billy was on his way back to Los Angeles. But he was very night. Nobody could be more of a gentleman than Billy Higgins.
Did he talk to you at all about—in preparation to take his chair in that band.
